status_vocabulary.VERIFIED PASS: Sufficient evidence for the specifically stated scope; inherited/file/arithmetic evidence is never a fresh manual behavior result.
status_vocabulary.VERIFIED FAIL: An applicable behavior or measurement is demonstrably failing, with evidence and scope.
status_vocabulary.NOT VERIFIED: Required evidence or a safe/reliable execution precondition is missing; blocks Gate B.
status_vocabulary.NOT APPLICABLE: Only the identified criterion/measurement is inapplicable, with explicit justification; missing fixtures are not exemptions.

preserved_gate_A.basis: Inherited WP7B-R1 Gate A PASS; original report and current R1-tested source preserved, no functional rerun.

gate_B_rule: PASS only if every required manual group has sufficient actual evidence or a justified applicable exemption, with no blocking demonstrated accessibility defect. File integrity, audibility, DOM, screenshots, axe and arithmetic cannot substitute for speech or native interaction.

environment.external_reads: Public W3C accessibility guidance only; no business/live-provider actions.

count_scope: 13 speech + 12 native zoom + 15 contrast/applicability/legacy review groups; not unique defects, per-element counts or comprehensive WCAG coverage.
retained_evidence_policy: Valid R1 observations remain valid for their exact recorded scope. No rerun is required solely because the phase changed. NOT VERIFIED review groups describe the unclosed remainder, not a downgrade of inherited sample PASS results.
